data.script: Erik: Food survey, question one! Mateo, pasta or rice? … Mateo: Pasta! Engineer food! … Mateo: What about Luna? … Erik: Luna voted with her tail: she likes meat. Big surprise! … Erik: Final result: everything is tasty when the Club eats together!
